gancho: Leí su celular a medianoche y…
estilo: Cinematic Mexican telenovela look, warm dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, subtle 35mm film grain, emotional close-ups, realistic people, natural Mexican Spanish acting
escenas: Dark bedroom at night, only a phone lighting the scene. LUCÍA (35, wavy brown hair, grey pajamas) wakes up as her husband's phone buzzes on the nightstand. She reads the screen; her face turns worried. RICARDO (37, beard, white t-shirt) sleeps beside her. She whispers: "¿«Ya le dijiste»?…"

Same dark bedroom. LUCÍA (35, wavy brown hair, grey pajamas) shakes RICARDO (37, beard, white t-shirt) awake and turns on the lamp, holding his phone up. Lucía, upset: "¿Qué tienes que decirme, Ricardo?" Ricardo sits up, nervous and caught.

Same bedroom, lamp on. RICARDO (37, beard, white t-shirt) sighs, opens the nightstand drawer and pulls out a small wrapped gift and a party invitation, handing them to LUCÍA (35, wavy brown hair, grey pajamas). He says: "Que mi hermana organizó tu fiesta sorpresa… y la acabas de arruinar." Lucía covers her face, embarrassed and touched.
caption: Pensó lo peor… y era todo lo contrario 🥹 ¿Tú habrías revisado el celular? #novela #drama #historiascortas #telenovela #giro
